changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ScoreItem') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] ( [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [Value] [bit] NULL, [AdjustedWeight] [decimal](8, 6) NULL, [RunDate] [datetime] NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [AssetVersionUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Evidence] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [ConditionUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [AdjustedMaxWeight] [decimal](8, 6) NULL, [DecimalValue] [float] NULL, [OtherConditions] [nvarchar](max) NOT NULL ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'ScoreItem' and COLUMN_NAME = 'DisplayWeight') BEGIN alter table metrics.ScoreItem add DisplayWeight decimal(8,6) null END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'ScoreItem' and COLUMN_NAME = 'DisplayMaxWeight') BEGIN alter table metrics.ScoreItem add DisplayMaxWeight decimal(8,6) null END
changeSet.rollback:
IF EXISTS (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'ScoreItem' and COLUMN_NAME = 'DisplayWeight') BEGIN alter table metrics.ScoreItem drop column DisplayWeight END
IF EXISTS (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'ScoreItem' and COLUMN_NAME = 'DisplayMaxWeight') BEGIN alter table metrics.ScoreItem drop column DisplayMaxWeight END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if not exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricScoreItem') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] ADD CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricScoreItem] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC ) end
if not exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricScoreItem_MetricAssetVersion') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItem_MetricAssetVersion] FOREIGN KEY([AssetVersionUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[AssetVersion] ([Uid]) ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItem_MetricAssetVersion] end
if not exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricScoreItem_MetricAssetVersionCondition') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItem_MetricAssetVersionCondition] FOREIGN KEY([ConditionUid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] ([Uid]) ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItem_MetricAssetVersionCondition] end
if not exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricScoreItem_Uid') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricScoreItem_Uid] DEFAULT (newid()) FOR [Uid] end
if not exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricsScoreItem_OtherConditions') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsScoreItem_OtherConditions] DEFAULT ('[]') FOR [OtherConditions] end
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricScoreItem_Uid') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricScoreItem_Uid] end
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricsScoreItem_OtherConditions') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsScoreItem_OtherConditions] end
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricScoreItem_MetricAssetVersion') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItem_MetricAssetVersion] end
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricScoreItem_MetricAssetVersionCondition') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricScoreItem_MetricAssetVersionCondition] end
if exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricScoreItem') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[ScoreItem] DROP CONSTRAINT PK_MetricScoreItem WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end

changeSet.sql: if not exists (SELECT * FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[metrics].[ScoreItem]') AND name = N'IX_metrics_ScoreItem_AssetVersionUid') begin CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_metrics_ScoreItem_AssetVersionUid] ON [metrics].[ScoreItem] ( [AssetVersionUid] ASC ) end
